Login.title: Welcome back.
Login.description: Get back into the rhythm of your restaurant.
Login.helpDescription: Your restaurant manager creates your staff account. Contact your manager if you cannot access it. Never share your password or verification codes.
Login.sceneDescription: From table to kitchen, everything in rhythm. A fresh take on the restaurant experience.
Login.successDescription: Your identity and session have been verified.
Login.successNotice: Do not leave your account open on a shared device. Sign out securely when you are finished.
Login.mfaPending: Two-step verification is required to complete your sign-in.
Login.mfaSetup: This ADMIN account requires initial two-step verification setup.
Login.mfaNotice: Staff access is not granted until two-step verification is complete. Sign out securely if you cannot continue on this device.

error.credentials: The email or password is incorrect, or the account is unavailable. Check your details.
error.invalidInput: Check the email and password format and try again.
error.security: Security verification could not be completed. Refresh the page and try again.
error.conflict: Your session state has changed. Refresh the page and try again.
error.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Wait a while before trying again.
error.retryAfter: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error.network: The connection was lost and the result could not be confirmed. Check your connection and refresh the page.
error.configuration: The sign-in connection is unavailable. Contact your restaurant manager.
error.unavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable. Please try again shortly.
error.language: The language could not be changed. Please try again.
